description: Block height API: current block number, slot or ledger index for Base, Polygon, Ethereum, Solana and XRPL in one GET. Optional network (comma list; default all five). Per network: chainId, height, headTime, headAgeSeconds, finalizedHeight and finalityGap (EVM finalized tag, Solana finalized slot, XRPL validated ledger). Free public RPCs, read-only. Billed when at least one network answers; bad input or every RPC down: not charged on Base (other rails may charge). Price $0.002 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only). Paid calls are subject to Horizon Pulse buyer terms: https://horizonpulse.dev/terms/buyer

network.description: Comma list of base, polygon, ethereum, solana, xrpl (or CAIP-2 ids); default all five
